metadata.description: Curated agent skills compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and more.

plugins.name: six-thinking-hats
plugins.description: Applies Edward de Bono's Six Thinking Hats as a sequential thinking-partner process. Selects hat-set modes (Full, Creative, Risk, Decision, Custom) and depth levels (Quick, Standard, Deep Dive) to match user intent. Use when the user asks for multi-angle reasoning, decision support, brainstorming with tradeoffs, or explicitly asks for Six Thinking Hats.
